cases.sentence: Царь Валтасар устроил ___ для тысячи своих приближенных и пил с ними вино.
cases.explain: «великий пир» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: Belshazzar the king made a great feast to a thousand of his lords, and drank wine before the thousand.

cases.sentence: Выпив вина, Валтасар приказал принести золотые и серебряные кубки, которые его дед Навуходоносор взял из ___.
cases.explain: «Иерусалимского храма» — after the preposition «из», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: Belshazzar, while he tasted the wine, commanded that the golden and silver vessels which Nebuchadnezzar his father had taken out of the temple which was in Jerusalem be brought to him; that the king and his lords, his wives and his concubines, might drink from them.

cases.sentence: Тотчас же появились пальцы ___, которые стали писать на штукатурке стены царского дворца, рядом со светильником.
cases.explain: «человеческой руки» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: In the same hour, the fingers of a man’s hand came out and wrote near the lamp stand on the plaster of the wall of the king’s palace. The king saw the part of the hand that wrote.

cases.sentence: Тотчас же появились пальцы человеческой руки, которые стали писать на штукатурке стены ___, рядом со светильником.
cases.explain: «царского дворца» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: In the same hour, the fingers of a man’s hand came out and wrote near the lamp stand on the plaster of the wall of the king’s palace. The king saw the part of the hand that wrote.

cases.sentence: Все ___ вошли, но не смогли ни прочитать надписи, ни объяснить царю ее смысл.
cases.explain: «царские мудрецы» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: Then all the king’s wise men came in; but they could not read the writing, and couldn’t make known to the king the interpretation.

cases.explain: «крайнем замешательстве» — after the preposition «в», for location or topic.
cases.translation: Then king Belshazzar was greatly troubled, and his face was changed in him, and his lords were perplexed.

cases.sentence: Услышав голоса царя и его приближенных, в ___ вошла царица .
cases.explain: «пиршественный зал» — after the preposition «в», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: The queen by reason of the words of the king and his lords came into the banquet house. The queen spoke and said, “O king, live forever; don’t let your thoughts trouble you, nor let your face be changed.

cases.sentence: В твоем царстве есть человек, в котором пребывает дух ___ .
cases.explain: «святых богов» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: There is a man in your kingdom, in whom is the spirit of the holy gods; and in the days of your father light and understanding and wisdom, like the wisdom of the gods, were found in him. The king Nebuchadnezzar your father, yes, the king, your father, made him master of the magicians, enchanters, Chaldeans, and soothsayers;

cases.sentence: В этом человеке, Данииле, которого царь назвал Белтешаццаром, нашлись проницательность, знание, разум и умение толковать сны, раскрывать загадки и разрешать ___.
cases.explain: «сложные задачи» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: because an excellent spirit, knowledge, understanding, interpreting of dreams, showing of dark sentences, and dissolving of doubts were found in the same Daniel, whom the king named Belteshazzar. Now let Daniel be called, and he will show the interpretation.”

cases.sentence: А о тебе я слышал, что ты можешь давать истолкования и разрешать ___.
cases.explain: «трудные задачи» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: But I have heard of you, that you can give interpretations, and dissolve doubts. Now if you can read the writing, and make known to me its interpretation, you shall be clothed with purple, and have a chain of gold around your neck, and shall be the third ruler in the kingdom.”

cases.sentence: Если ты сможешь прочитать эту надпись и объяснить мне ее смысл, то тебя оденут в пурпур, возложат тебе на шею золотую цепь, и ты станешь ___ в царстве.
cases.explain: «третьим человеком» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: But I have heard of you, that you can give interpretations, and dissolve doubts. Now if you can read the writing, and make known to me its interpretation, you shall be clothed with purple, and have a chain of gold around your neck, and shall be the third ruler in the kingdom.”

cases.sentence: От величия, которое Он ему дал, все народы, племена и люди, говорящие на ___, трепетали перед ним и боялись его.
cases.explain: «разных языках» — after the preposition «на», for location or topic.
cases.translation: Because of the greatness that he gave him, all the peoples, nations, and languages trembled and feared before him. He killed whom he wanted to, and he kept alive whom he wanted to. He raised up whom he wanted to, and he put down whom he wanted to.
